resources.string: To help you message people you know, Backchannel will request these permissions.
Backchannel would like to request the notification permission. This allows your device to display alerts when new messages arrive.
Backchannel needs the location permission to discover and connect with your old device.
Backchannel needs location services enabled to discover and connect with your old device.
Backchannel needs Wi-Fi turned on to discover and connect with your old device.
This version of Backchannel can\'t restore your backup. Update to the latest version and try again.
